Resource_Provisioner.message: Logistics check complete for this phase: no critical alerts, no open deficit requests, and no shortages below critical levels at either hospital. Provisioner stock is healthy. Departments — if you plan heavy scheduling this phase (especially Radiology or Ward steps), post any deficit requests EARLY; I respond same-phase with full top-ups sized to reach safe buffers, not dribbles. Zero failures is the priority.
